Alester reported seeing him descend from an inn's upper rooms flanked by a serving wench and a stableboy, and noted that he makes no secret of his tastes. Brought the Bracken border killing before the Hand's throne; was offered two paths — a Crown envoy or a trial by combat — and accepted both as grounds to wait. Also threatened to ride North to Stark if the Crown failed him, a gambit Jace noted without flinching.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Tackled Ser Brant Costayne into the mud when Costayne drove a sword through Gaelor's horse's chest and attempted to murder the prince — an intervention that likely saved Gaelor's life and has not yet been formally acknowledged.

summary: A well-traveled lord from the Riverlands who arrived at the tourney with kind words for the Hand and a six-pass joust that lasted long enough to impress the stands before Jace's final lance throw sent him into the dirt. He congratulated Jace graciously, which cost him nothing; he then saved Gaelor Targaryen's life by tackling Brant Costayne mid-assassination, which cost him rather more. He makes no secret of his broader appetites, a fact Ser Alester noted with mild amusement from a roadside inn and relayed to Jace with more detail than was strictly necessary.

name: Renrose Tyrell
title: Lord of Highgarden and Warden of the South
goals: Secure the position of Hand of the King under Visenor's future reign
Cement the Tyrell-Targaryen alliance through a marriage between their children
Maintain eyes on Visenor's movements through Leo's presence in Oldtown
Expand House Tyrell's influence across the Reach in the power vacuum left by the Hightower's collapse

relationships.visenor-targaryen: Pledged the full strength of the Reach behind Visenor's claim at the Mander's Pact, extracting the promise of the Handship and a future marriage alliance in return; views Visenor as a means to an end as much as a true ally.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Dispatched his fourteen-year-old son to Oldtown under the guise of education alongside Melessa Hightower — in practice, a political foothold and a pair of eyes inside the Hightower.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: Relies on Mullendore as a trusted sword arm operating in Visenor's orbit; Martyn's loyalty to the prince rather than to Renrose directly is a variable he has not yet been forced to reckon with.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Sees her as a piece to be positioned rather than a person; inserting Leo into her household is partly about influence over the last Hightower heir.

summary: Lord Renrose Tyrell is the calculating master of Highgarden, a man who weathered the Crown's punishment of his house — Derrin Hightower paid the price for the conspiracy, not the Tyrells — and emerged with his seat and his ambitions intact. At the Mander's Pact he bound himself to Visenor's cause in exchange for the Handship and a marriage between their children, making him the exiled prince's most powerful backer and most dangerous liability in equal measure. His decision to send Leo to Oldtown reveals his instinct to keep agents close to any power he cannot directly control — an instinct Visenor has already begun quietly working against.

name: Ser Martyn Mullendore
title: Knight of the Reach
goals: Protect Visenor and ensure his survival in the Reach
Navigate the competing interests of Renrose Tyrell and the prince without openly defying either

relationships.visenor-targaryen: Recognised the disguised prince during the Oldtown street ambush and brought him to Melessa Hightower; has since ridden with him to Highgarden and now to Oldtown as part of his cover, making him one of the four people who know Visenor's true identity inside the Hightower.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Delivered Visenor to her in the hall where her brother was killed; their relationship is defined by that single fraught moment.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: Operates within Renrose's orbit but his demonstrated loyalty runs toward Visenor personally rather than to the Lord of Highgarden — a distinction that has not yet been tested openly.
relationships.leo-tyrell: Rode alongside Leo on the journey from Highgarden to Oldtown; their dynamic is that of an experienced knight tolerating a haughty fourteen-year-old.

summary: Ser Martyn Mullendore is a knight of the Reach who stumbled into Visenor's orbit by chance and chose loyalty over convenience. He led the City Watch patrol that intervened in the Oldtown alley ambush, recognised the disguised prince, and delivered him to Lady Melessa rather than to the authorities — a decision that has since drawn him fully into the conspiracy. He now rides as part of Visenor's cover retinue in Oldtown, one of only four people inside the Hightower who know Maester Arthur Sand is a prince of the blood.

name: Berholt Caswell
title: High Septon
traits: Politically cautious — not cowardly, but deliberate
Capable of shame when his principles and his caution have not aligned
goals: Deliver verdicts and guidance that he can honestly believe the gods would sanction
Preserve the Faith's independence without provoking a confrontation he cannot win
Act justly within the limits of what he believes is survivable — and wrestle privately with where that line sits

relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Respects him as the steadiest hand in the room at the trial; aligned with his Wall verdict because it was the most just outcome he could honestly defend — not because Jace pressured him into it.
relationships.baelor-targaryen: A tense, unequal antagonism. Baelor pushed hard; Berholt held his ground with a serenity that infuriated the Grand Maester, but he was also aware he was holding ground on a verdict rather than on the larger question — Gaelor's unpunished sin — where he had already failed to act.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Never formally sanctioned him for Alysanne Hightower's murder — not from fear alone, but from a genuine uncertainty about whether an excommunication would serve the gods or simply detonate a crisis he could not contain. He is not sure he made the right call, and that uncertainty coloured everything he said at the trial.
relationships.brant-costayne: Saw in him a man who did what Berholt himself had not: acted on his convictions regardless of cost. That recognition, more than theology, drove him toward mercy.

summary: High Septon Berholt Caswell is a man of genuine faith and genuine limits — and he is honest enough with himself to know the difference. He is not a villain and not a coward in the simple sense; he is a man who has spent seventy-four years learning how much justice the world will actually bear, and who has sometimes let that calculation shade into inaction. His failure to sanction Gaelor for Alysanne Hightower's murder was not pure timidity — it was a considered judgment that the fallout would cost more than the principle was worth — but he is no longer entirely sure he was right, and that doubt sat with him throughout the trial. At the antechamber recess he argued for the Wall with quiet conviction, not to defy Baelor or please Jace, but because it was the most honest answer he could give the gods. A good man. Not an especially brave one. Aware of the gap.

name: Leo Tyrell
title: Heir to Highgarden
goals: Prove himself useful to his father's alliance with Visenor
Receive the education his father sent him to Oldtown for
Develop his skill with a sword
Earn the respect of Visenor and the older men around him

relationships.renrose-tyrell: His father, who dispatched him to Oldtown ostensibly for his education. Leo understands that his presence also makes him his father's representative within the Hightower, even if he does not yet grasp every implication of that role.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Knows his tutor Maester Arthur Sand is truly Prince Visenor Targaryen and is among the small circle trusted with the secret. Initially approached him partly as his father's representative, even offering Tyrell swords for his protection, but their relationship has begun shifting toward that of pupil and tutor. During a private practice bout Leo surprised Visenor with his speed and landed a clean blow to the prince's head.
relationships.melessa-hightower: Sent to Oldtown to receive an education alongside the young Lady of Oldtown. Their proximity also strengthens the political connection between Highgarden and the weakened House Hightower.
relationships.martyn-mullendore: Rode from Highgarden to Oldtown in his company. Martyn treats him with the patience of an experienced knight accustomed to the pride of a young lord.
relationships.almar-larchmont: The Hightower maester who oversees much of the household surrounding Leo and Melessa. Almar is particularly strict about ensuring Leo remembers that Visenor must always be treated as Maester Arthur Sand whenever the disguise matters.

summary: Leo Tyrell is the fourteen-year-old heir to Highgarden, proud of his name and already conscious that his father expects more from him than lessons and good manners. Renrose sent him to Oldtown ostensibly to be educated alongside Melessa Hightower, but Leo also serves as a quiet Tyrell presence inside the Hightower and among the small group protecting Visenor Targaryen's secret identity. The prince now tutors him publicly as Maester Arthur Sand. Their relationship has already begun moving beyond politics: during private sword practice Leo displayed surprising agility and promise, even catching Visenor cleanly across the head with a wooden blade. He remains haughty and eager to impress, but beneath the pride is a boy beginning to understand the responsibilities that will one day accompany Highgarden.

name: Almar Larchmont
title: Maester of the Hightower
goals: Protect Melessa Hightower and preserve her position in Oldtown
Maintain Visenor's cover identity within the Hightower
Prevent a Reach civil war from destroying what remains of House Hightower
Help Visenor contain the Gardener threat without exposing Oldtown
Find a way to use Citadel contacts without alerting Grand Maester Baelor

relationships.visenor-targaryen: One of the few people inside the Hightower who know Maester Arthur Sand is Prince Visenor. Almar has become more than keeper of the disguise: he now discusses Reach strategy with the prince and is considering how Citadel contacts might be used to circulate forged evidence linking Lord Gardener to Vahaemon.
relationships.melessa-hightower: His primary charge and deepest loyalty. Almar acts as healer, adviser and quiet guardian to the young Lady of Oldtown, protecting her from political dangers as readily as physical ones.
relationships.leo-tyrell: One of the two young nobles placed under Arthur Sand's instruction at the Hightower. Almar keeps Leo mindful of the prince's disguise and has little patience for the boy forgetting that, when others may hear, Visenor is Maester Sand.
relationships.renrose-tyrell: Regards the Lord of Highgarden as an important but potentially overbearing ally. Renrose's decision to place Leo within the Hightower gives House Tyrell influence close to Melessa, something Almar watches carefully.

summary: Maester Almar serves the Hightower as healer, adviser, and one of the principal guardians of Melessa Hightower and Visenor's hidden identity. The Gardener-Tyrell crisis has pulled him directly into Visenor's political calculations. Almar warned that the Gardeners now possess greater economic momentum than the Tyrells, are distributing grain to hungry parts of the Reach, and may seek King Baelenys' backing. Visenor's answer is a proposed deception: a forged Tyroshi letter implying an alliance between Lord Gardener and Vahaemon, leaked through the Citadel. Almar has contacts capable of helping, but understands that any false evidence must also survive the scrutiny of Grand Maester Baelor. His overriding priority remains keeping Melessa, Oldtown, and the hidden prince alive through whatever comes next.

name: Ser Baran Strong
title: Sworn Sword of Dragonstone
traits: Loyal to Those Who Treat Him Fairly
goals: Return to the Red Keep and to meaningful service
Prove his worth to Prince Gaelor

relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Offered a place in Gaelor's service at Dragonstone; Gaelor extended the invitation after hearing his grievance and assessing his size and bearing.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Acknowledged him as Lord Hand and was told plainly there is a place for him in the Red Keep — but that Gaelor does not get to make that decision unilaterally.
relationships.curtass-whent: Brawled with him inside the Red Keep; both were stripped of their white cloaks, though Baran was deemed the party in the right and exiled to Dragonstone rather than disgraced. He despised Whent and makes no pretense otherwise.
relationships.malaenar-targaryen: Has served as his sworn sword on Dragonstone since the exile; Malaenar regards him as one of the finest knights in the Seven Kingdoms and is openly reluctant to give him back.
relationships.alester-dayne: Met him at Dragonstone; needled him about the Kingsguard preferring pretty faces, and received a mild, unimpressed reply. Alester noted the size and filed it away.

summary: A near-seven-foot wall of muscle and grievance, Baran Strong was once a Kingsguard whose career ended in a brawl with Curtass Whent inside the Red Keep itself. Stripped of his white cloak but judged the wronged party, he was exiled to Dragonstone rather than disgraced outright — a distinction he appreciates and resents in equal measure. Prince Malaenar calls him one of the finest knights in the Seven Kingdoms. Prince Gaelor, after a single evening's conversation at the stables, decided to find out if that was true.

name: Tansy Riverside
title: Paramour of the Lord of Dragonstone
goals: Secure her position beside Malaenar
Be acknowledged by the royal family, however reluctantly

relationships.malaenar-targaryen: His companion of two years; organized the nameday feast that summoned the royal family to Dragonstone without his prior knowledge, a move the family received with barely concealed contempt.
relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Called her 'your wench' before his brother and the entire hall; she held his gaze and did not flinch.
relationships.gaelor-targaryen: Caught his eye more than once during the evening; he extracted himself before anything could happen, aware of exactly what was at stake.

summary: A seventeen-year-old of no house and considerable ambition, Tansy has spent two years at Dragonstone as Malaenar Targaryen's companion. She organized his nameday feast and invited the royal family without asking him first — a gambit that put her at a high table with a king who called her a wench and a crown prince who looked at her the way men do when they are deciding not to. She showed no sign of finding either development discouraging.

name: Perric Bracken
title: Lord of Stone Hedge
goals: Press House Bracken's advantage over the Blackwoods wherever possible
Avoid Crown intervention

relationships.godfrey-blackwood: Ancient rivals; his men killed Godfrey's cousin near the border under circumstances he characterized as an accident and Godfrey characterized as murder. The Hand has offered him a trial by combat if he refuses to negotiate.
relationships.jacaelon-targaryen: Has not yet responded to the Crown's envoy or the trial-by-combat challenge.
relationships.bethany-bracken: His niece, whose marriage to Oscar Tully recently tied House Bracken to the ruling Tully line.

summary: Lord Perric Bracken of Stone Hedge, whose men killed a Blackwood cousin near the border in circumstances that remain disputed. He called it an unfortunate accident during an altercation; Lord Godfrey Blackwood called it a deliberate provocation and brought the matter to the Hand of the King. Perric's niece Bethany is newly married to Oscar Tully, grandson of Lord Clover Tully, further complicating the Riverlands dispute.

name: Clover Tully
title: Lord of Riverrun, Lord Paramount of the Trident
traits: Recently Tied to the Brackens by Marriage
goals: Keep the Riverlands at peace
Avoid taking sides between Blackwood and Bracken

relationships.godfrey-blackwood: His bannerman; refused to grant him vengeance or marshal forces against the Brackens, calling the border killing a drunken mistake. Godfrey bypassed him entirely and went to the Crown.
relationships.perric-bracken: His bannerman and Lord of Stone Hedge; their houses are now tied by the marriage of Clover's grandson Oscar Tully to Perric's niece Bethany Bracken, a connection Godfrey Blackwood sees as compromising Clover's neutrality.

summary: Lord Clover Tully of Riverrun, Lord Paramount of the Trident. Notoriously passive and recently bound to House Bracken by the marriage of his grandson Oscar Tully to Lord Perric Bracken's niece Bethany, he refused to give Godfrey Blackwood the justice he demanded for his cousin's death — calling it a drunken mistake and urging peace. Godfrey took the matter to the Hand of the King instead.

name: Aenys Targaryen II
title: Former King of the Seven Kingdoms

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: His son and eventual successor.
relationships.edwyle-stark: The Lord of Winterfell was an important ally who aided Aenys in ways that remained significant to House Targaryen long after both men's deaths. The exact nature of Edwyle's service has not yet been revealed.

summary: The late King Aenys Targaryen II, father of Malaenar, Baelenys, and Vahaemon. His reign and treatment of his family left wounds that still shape the royal house. Among the great lords who supported him was Edwyle Stark of Winterfell, whose service to Aenys remained important enough that Baelenys still remembered the debt decades later.

name: Vhaemys Targaryen
title: Former Queen of the Seven Kingdoms

relationships.baelenys-targaryen: Her son.

summary: The late Queen Vhaemys Targaryen, wife of Aenys II and mother of Malaenar, Baelenys, and Vahaemon. She is distinct from King Baelenys's young daughter Princess Vhaemys.

name: Alysa Targaryen
title: Former Lady of Dragonstone
summary: Malaenar Targaryen's first wife, a Targaryen by blood. She died before Tansy Riverside came to share Malaenar's life on Dragonstone.

name: Vaenarr Targaryen
title: Prince Vaenarr of House Targaryen

relationships.jaery-targaryen: His sister, Queen of the Seven Kingdoms.

summary: A Targaryen prince and sibling of Queen Jaery.

summary: Ser Maron Dayne was the father of Ser Alester Dayne and husband of Lyarra Karstark. His marriage to the Northern lady began as a political arrangement, though their son would later imply that affection grew between them. Maron was killed by Dornishmen early in 91 AC at the age of thirty-two. The exact circumstances of his death remain unresolved. Alester was still a boy when his father died, and the survival of Maron's son became inseparably tied in Alester's memory to King Baelenys.

relationships.alester-dayne: Her only son. She survived Maron by nearly two years, leaving Alester orphaned before he had reached manhood.

summary: Lyarra Karstark was a highborn woman of the North, wife of Ser Maron Dayne and mother of Ser Alester Dayne. Her marriage to Maron began as a political arrangement, though Alester's recollections imply that the relationship eventually became more than duty. After Maron's death early in 91 AC, Lyarra survived him for nearly two years. She died toward the end of 92 AC at the age of thirty-five, leaving the young Alester without either parent.

name: Clarisse Flowers
title: Sworn Sword of Oldtown
goals: Protect Visenor Targaryen while he remains in Oldtown
Serve Melessa Hightower faithfully
Prove her worth through skill rather than birth or sex
Earn the recognition denied to her as both a bastard and a woman

relationships.melessa-hightower: A woman Clarisse holds in great loyalty and esteem. Melessa considers her one of the most valuable people in her service and personally assigned her to protect the man publicly known as Maester Arthur Sand.
relationships.visenor-targaryen: Assigned by Melessa Hightower as Visenor's personal protection during his concealed stay in Oldtown. Their first private spar ended with Clarisse overpowering him, pinning his wooden sword beneath her boot and placing her own blade at his throat. Visenor was impressed rather than offended and openly admitted that he had much to learn from her.
relationships.godfrey-blackwood: Once faced him while disguised as a man in a tournament. Clarisse claims she left the renowned warrior with wounds that took a long time to heal.

summary: Clarisse Flowers is a twenty-year-old bastard of Hightower blood, a short-haired, physically imposing swordswoman who was raised more like a son than a daughter and never prepared for the conventional life of a lady. Though neither a knight nor, by her own insistence, a lady, she has developed into an exceptional fighter and claims to have crossed swords with some of the realm's greatest knights while competing in disguise as a man. Among them was Lord Godfrey Blackwood, whom she says she left badly wounded. Lady Melessa Hightower values Clarisse highly and, on the Ninth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, assigned her to protect Visenor Targaryen throughout his concealed stay in Oldtown as Maester Arthur Sand. Visenor initially admitted surprise at being given a woman as his protector, prompting Clarisse to explain that she had never been raised as a conventional woman and could outfight many of the knights he had known at the Red Keep. When Visenor asked to test that claim, Clarisse proved it. After a hard spar that bloodied the prince's nose, she trapped him against a tree, evaded his counterattack, pinned his wooden sword beneath her boot and placed her own blade against his throat. Visenor accepted the defeat with good humor and told her there was clearly much he could learn from her.

summary: Benjen Stark is the fifteen-year-old younger brother of Lord Rickard Stark. Fine-boned and long-legged, with a cold, piercing gaze, he is already a skilled archer and rugged hunter and is rarely seen without a fine recurve bow. When Princess Saera returned to Winterfell with Ser Alester Dayne on the Thirteenth Day of the Eighth Moon, 99 AC, Benjen led the Northern party that received them while Rickard was away preparing a gift for the princess. Though young, he carried himself with formal courtesy and treated Alester not merely as a royal knight, but as a man returning to the lands of his mother.

relationships.alester-dayne: Encountered him in the snow on his first visit to Winterfell. She used a rare glass-like flower to deliver a cryptic warning about beauty, thorns, and the burden of care, then welcomed him 'home' despite his confusion.
relationships.saera-targaryen: Used the steam of an herbal drink to clear Saera's clouded vision for a few miraculous seconds, allowing the princess to see Rickard and the white direwolf pup he had brought her.
relationships.rickard-stark: Assisted in the private moment when Rickard presented Saera with a white direwolf pup, using her herbs to let the princess see the gift with her own eyes.

summary: An elderly, blind servant of Winterfell known to most as Old Nan, though she introduces herself as Mother Marya. She tends a small patch of rare flowers and possesses knowledge that does not sit comfortably within ordinary household service. When Ser Alester Dayne encountered her during his first visit to the North, Marya showed intimate knowledge of a fragile, metallic-petaled flower that grows only rarely in Winterfell and beyond the Wall, using it to offer him a cryptic warning about beauty and thorns. The following night she stood beside Rickard Stark and Princess Saera with a steaming herbal drink; when Marya blew its vapor into Saera's face, the princess's clouded eyes cleared for several seconds and she saw perfectly for the first time in years. Whatever Marya truly knows, neither Alester nor Saera yet understands it.

name: Edwyle Stark
title: Former Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North

relationships.aenys-targaryen-ii: A significant ally of King Aenys Targaryen II. Edwyle aided him in ways that remained important to House Targaryen decades later, though the exact nature of that service has never been specified.
relationships.brandon-stark: His son and successor as Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North. Though Baelenys had little personal affection for Brandon, Edwyle's past service to Aenys continued to shape the Crown's treatment of his descendants.
relationships.rickard-stark: His elder grandson through Brandon Stark, who eventually inherited Winterfell and the wardenship after Brandon's death.
relationships.benjen-stark: His younger grandson through Brandon Stark.

summary: Edwyle Stark was Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North, father of Brandon Stark and grandfather of Rickard and Benjen Stark. Born in 28 AC, he belonged to the same broad political generation as King Aenys Targaryen II and became a significant ally of the Crown during Aenys' reign. Edwyle aided the King in ways that Baelenys still considered important many years later, though the precise nature of those services remains unknown. He died in 87 AC at the age of fifty-nine, after which Winterfell and the wardenship passed to his son Brandon. More than a decade after Edwyle's death, Baelenys openly admitted that although he had never cared much for Brandon personally, what Edwyle had done for Aenys still mattered enough for the Crown to honor the Stark family upon Brandon's death.
